Definition: Zuzites, an aboriginal tribe of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: The Zuzim were an ancient people east of the Jordan, smitten by Chedorlaomer and his allied kings in the fourteenth year of their campaign, at Ham. They appear once, as one of the peoples swept aside in the war that ended with Abram rescuing Lot. We know almost nothing about them except that they were there — and that they fell.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Zuzim remind me that whole peoples can pass from the record in a single verse, and that God alone remembers every name the histories forget.
